verdicts.reason: A restacks the layout, but the left edges are all different: GLACIER starts at about x370, the headline and body at about 255, the badges at about 310 and the CTA at about 370. GLACIER floats on its own to the right of the circle, there's a dead area beside the can, and the badges and CTA drift right, so the layout looks arbitrary. B keeps one clean left edge and a clear hierarchy but just stretches the original two-column layout to the full height. The headline, body copy, badges and CTA end up separated by huge, uneven gaps, so they no longer read as one group. The body copy is small and isolated, and the top-left and bottom-left corners are empty. B is slightly less broken because its alignment holds.
